chunks: Place your religion and your world at Allah’s disposal, and beg Him to ordain the best for you in respect of the near and the far, this world and the next; and that is an end to the matter.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali advise Hasan to say when returning from Siffin?
ai.summary: Delivered during the pivotal post-Siffin period, this instruction reflects Imam Ali’s strategic patience and theological reliance on divine wisdom amidst political turmoil, urging Hasan to prioritize spiritual integrity over immediate worldly gains. It encapsulates the Shia concept of *tawakkul* (trust in God) while acknowledging the duality of *al-'ajila* (the present) and *al-ajila* (the future), reinforcing the belief that God’s decree encompasses both temporal stability and eternal salvation. This guidance serves as a foundational model for navigating uncertainty with faith and composure.
